## Samsung Launches Galaxy Z Fold8, Flip8, Watch Ultra2, and Watch9 Across Southeast Asia and Oceania

Samsung sustaining its premium foldable push in Southeast Asia is strategically important as a defense against Chinese OEM encroachment in the region; secondary signal for component suppliers exposed to foldable demand in the supply chain.

- Samsung officially launched the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Fold8, Flip8, Watch Ultra2, and Watch9 in Southeast Asia and Oceania, including Australia.
- The rollout covers both premium foldable smartphones and high-end wearables simultaneously.
- The regional expansion signals Samsung's continued push to grow premium handset share in Asia-Pacific markets.
- Minor secondary read for component suppliers serving the foldable display and compact memory supply chain.
